T: Ten grand. One bad afternoon at the beach.
D: A young Kings Cross doorman loses a gangster's money at Bondi and has a day to get it back.
P: Serve the snacks when Jimmy heads down to Bondi.
S: Lager-battered flathead with thick twice-fried chips, wrapped to go
Flathead dusted in flour, dipped in a batter of flour and ice-cold lager, fried at 180C for 4 minutes, with thick chips, lemon and tartare, wrapped in paper and eaten on the sand.
Beef pie sitting on a bowl of buttery crushed peas
Small beef pies braised 2.5 hours in stock and Worcestershire, baked in shortcrust with a puff lid, served sitting in mushy peas with tomato sauce on top.
the gangster's crew killing time at his place

Thick potato slices dipped in a crisp batter and fried golden, the fish-shop classic, hit with chicken salt and served with tomato sauce and lemon. Peel 3 large potatoes and slice 1cm thick, then simmer for 4 minutes until just tender and pat dry. Whisk 150g self-raising flour, a pinch of salt and 230ml ice-cold soda water into a batter. Dust the slices in flour, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 4 to 5 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain, sprinkle with chicken salt and serve with tomato sauce and lemon.
M: Sichuan pepper squid and egg fried rice
Crisp rice-flour squid with chilli and scallion, jasmine rice fried with egg
Squid scored and cut, dusted in rice flour and Sichuan salt and pepper, fried at 190C for 60 seconds, tossed with chilli and spring onion, with egg fried rice.
Suburban Sunday roast pork and crackling
the family house out in the suburbs

Pork belly roasted until the crackling shatters, with crisp potatoes, honey pumpkin, apple sauce and gravy, the full Sydney Sunday spread. Score the skin of a 1.5kg pork belly, pat dry, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 90 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes and 600g pumpkin drizzled with honey alongside for the last hour. Simmer 3 chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and water until soft for sauce. Make gravy with the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Crisp meringue with a soft centre, whipped cream and passionfruit
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar until glossy, cornflour and vinegar folded in, baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with cream and passionfruit.
K: Cold lager topped with passionfruit, lime and soda, half a passionfruit on top

Cold lager topped with fresh passionfruit and lime soda in chilled schooner glasses, a passionfruit half floating on top. Stir the pulp of 4 passionfruit, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp caster sugar until dissolved, then add 400ml cold soda water. Pour 200ml cold lager into each of 4 chilled schooner glasses, top with the passionfruit soda and float half a passionfruit on top.

Serve together.

s.note: Lager-battered flathead with thick twice-fried chips, wrapped to go
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C until soft. Whisk flour with ice-cold lager to a thin batter. Dip 600g flathead in flour, then batter, and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry the chips again until crisp and wrap it all in paper with lemon and tartare.

s.note: Beef pie sitting on a bowl of buttery crushed peas
s.how: Braise 800g diced beef chuck in stock for 2.5 hours, thicken and cool. Bake in shortcrust cases with puff lids at 200C for 30 minutes. Cook 500g peas and mash roughly with butter. Spoon peas into bowls, sit a pie on top and finish with tomato sauce.

m.n: Sichuan pepper squid and egg fried rice
m.note: Crisp rice-flour squid with chilli and scallion, jasmine rice fried with egg
m.how: Score 500g squid tubes and cut into pieces. Toss in rice flour with ground Sichuan pepper and salt and fry at 190C for 60 seconds. Toss with chilli and sliced spring onion. Fry cold cooked jasmine rice with scrambled egg and spring onion and serve together.

w.note: Crisp meringue with a soft centre, whipped cream and passionfruit

d.how: Stir the pulp of 4 passionfruit, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp caster sugar until dissolved, then add 400ml cold soda water. Pour 200ml cold lager into each of 4 chilled schooner glasses, top with the passionfruit soda and float half a passionfruit on top.
